app.title: ErgScan
app.tagline: Scan your Concept2 PM4/PM5 results and export a FIT file

capture.hint: Photograph the PM4/PM5 results screen straight on, with the table filling most of the frame and no glare on the digits.

guide.title: Get the right screen
guide.open: How to get the results screen

pick.question: Which monitor do you have?
pick.hint: The menus differ a little between the two models, so the steps are made for yours.

pm5.name: Concept2 PM5
pm5.look: Black monitor with Units, Display and Menu buttons below the screen

pm4.name: Concept2 PM4
pm4.look: Grey monitor with Change Units, Change Display and Menu {'|'} Back buttons
pm4.memoryPath: More Options › Memory › List by Date › 🔍
pm4.memoryNote: The PM4 only keeps the 10 most recent workouts, so open the results before your next session.
pm4.logCardNote: If a LogCard is in the monitor, the workout is saved on the card instead: open LogCard Menu › List by Date › 🔍 from the Welcome screen.

guide.intro: ErgScan reads the results table with the total and the splits. Follow these steps on the monitor so that table is what you photograph.

setup.title: Start a workout
setup.body: Pick a set distance or set time workout so the result is split into parts. Just Row also works: start rowing from the main menu.
setup.path: Select Workout › Standard List, or New Workout › Single Distance / Single Time

finish.title: Finish it properly
finish.body: A set distance or time workout ends by itself when the countdown reaches zero, so keep rowing until then. For Just Row, stop rowing, wait 6 seconds and press {menu} once. Row at least 1 minute or 100 m, or nothing is saved.
finish.warning: Don't press {menu} mid-workout or during a rest: it ends the workout.

results.title: Open the results
results.body: From the main menu, open the workout from memory. Find it with the arrows (check the date and time), then press the magnifying glass button to see the total and every split.
results.note: If the monitor goes dark, press a button to wake it. The workout stays in memory.

photo.title: Take the photo
photo.body: Hold the phone straight in front of the screen, let the table fill the frame and avoid glare on the digits. Then tap Scan with camera.

camera.hint: Fit the PM screen inside the frame
camera.qrHint: Point the camera at the pairing QR code
camera.failed: The camera could not be started ({message}). Take or choose a photo instead.
camera.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or take or choose a photo instead.
camera.missing: No camera was found. Choose a photo instead.
camera.busy: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again, or choose a photo instead.
camera.stalled: The camera isn't responding. If your browser is asking for permission, allow it, then try again.

scan.failed: No results table was found. Try another photo or enter the workout manually.
scan.moreFailed: No rows were found in that photo. The splits from the earlier photos are kept; try again.
scan.offline: You're offline and the text reader hasn't been downloaded yet. Connect once and try again, or enter the workout manually.

review.title: Check the results
review.computedSummary: The total was not found on the screen, so it was calculated from the rows.
review.moreRows: The splits don't add up to the total yet. Press the down arrow on the monitor to show the next rows, then scan them.
review.name: Name
review.invalidCells: Fix the highlighted cells. Enter times like 8:00.0 (or 8.00.0) and other values as whole numbers.

zones.title: Heart rate zones
zones.bar: Time in each heart rate zone
zones.basis: From the average heart rate of each split and a max heart rate of {bpm} bpm.
zones.basisWatch: From your watch's heart rate, second by second, and a max heart rate of {bpm} bpm.
zones.missingMax: Set your max heart rate or age in Settings to see time in heart rate zones.

z1.name: UT3
z1.description: Recovery, very easy, for warm-up and cool-down

z2.name: UT2
z2.description: Easy, steady rowing at 18–20 strokes a minute that builds your aerobic base, not hard rowing at a low rate

z3.name: UT1
z3.description: Steady and comfortably hard, at 20–24 strokes a minute

z4.name: AT
z4.description: Anaerobic threshold, hard but sustainable for 20 to 30 minutes, at 24–28 strokes a minute

z5.name: TR
z5.description: Transport, race-pace intervals at 28–32 strokes a minute

z6.name: AN
z6.description: Anaerobic, all out at a high rate, only for short efforts

history.title: History
history.empty: Scan or enter a workout and tap Save to keep it here.
history.pick: Its splits open here, ready to edit, share or download.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showIntroDetail: The welcome card with the photo tip
settings.maxHrDetail: Measured, in beats per minute. Leave empty to estimate it from your age
settings.ageDetail: Estimates max heart rate as 220 minus your age
settings.ageUnused: Not used while a measured max heart rate is set
settings.exportDetail: No saved workouts to export | Saves your workout to a file you can restore later | Saves your {count} workouts to a file you can restore later
settings.exported: Saved {name}. Keep it somewhere outside this browser.
settings.restoreDetail: Adds the workouts from an exported file. Workouts already here are kept as they are
settings.restored: No workouts were added. | Added 1 workout. | Added {count} workouts.
settings.restoreSkipped: 1 was skipped because it's already here or was deleted. | {count} were skipped because they're already here or were deleted.
settings.restoreInvalid: That file isn't an ErgScan history export, or it's damaged. Nothing was changed.
settings.clearDetail: No saved workouts. Resets the theme, intro and heart rate, and shows the guide again | Deletes 1 saved workout, resets the theme, intro and heart rate, and shows the guide again | Deletes {count} saved workouts, resets the theme, intro and heart rate, and shows the guide again

export.invalid: Fill in the total time and distance to save the workout.
export.saveFirst: Save the workout to share or download the FIT file.

sync.title: Private sync
sync.detail: Link your devices to sync saved workouts with end-to-end encryption. Scanning, editing and saving work offline.
sync.scan: Scan this code with your linked device, or copy the pairing code there. It expires in five minutes.
sync.keepRecovery: Save this recovery key now. You’ll need it if you lose access to all your linked devices. Anyone with the key can access your synced history.
sync.readQr: Photograph or choose a pairing QR code
sync.approved: Device approved. The other device can now finish linking.
sync.erased: Synced history deleted. This device still has its local copy.
sync.requestRejected: The code or device access was rejected. Check the code and try again.
sync.requestFailed: The sync request failed. Check your connection and try again.
sync.inviteExpired: The pairing code expired. Create a new one to link.
sync.qrFailed: No pairing QR code was found in the image. Try again or paste the pairing code.
sync.needLinked: Open the code on a device that already has sync enabled.
sync.storageFailed: ErgScan couldn’t access workout storage. Your unsaved edits are still in the editor. Try again after checking available browser storage.
sync.deletedEdit: This workout was deleted on another device. You can still export the edits in this editor.
sync.pending: 1 change saved on this device | {count} changes saved on this device

state.offline: Offline. Workouts are saved on this device.
state.unlinked: This device’s access ended. Your local workouts are available here.
state.failed: Sync failed. Changes are kept on this device.
state.tooLarge: History exceeds the sync size limit. Changes are kept on this device.

syncApprove.title: Approve a new device?
syncApprove.body: Approve only if you can see the pairing code on your other device.

syncRevoke.title: Remove this device?
syncRevoke.body: It will lose access to sync. Copies already on that device can still be opened there.

syncDisconnect.title: Disconnect this device?
syncDisconnect.body: Your current workouts stay here. Pending changes will stay local and synced history remains available on other linked devices.

syncErase.title: Delete synced history?
syncErase.body: This permanently deletes the history on the sync server and disconnects all devices. Local copies can still be opened on each device.

syncClear.title: Clear this device?
syncClear.body: This deletes the workouts and settings on this device. Your synced history stays on the server.

syncClearPending.title: Clear this device?
syncClearPending.body: This deletes workouts, settings and pending changes saved on this device. Your existing synced history stays on the server.

discardNew.title: Discard workout?
discardNew.body: It hasn't been saved to History.

discardChanges.title: Discard changes?
discardChanges.body: Your edits to this workout will be lost.

remove.title: Delete workout?
remove.body: The workout from {date} will be deleted. This can't be undone.

removeMany.title: Delete workouts?
removeMany.body: The {count} selected workouts will be deleted. This can't be undone.

clear.title: Clear all data?
clear.body: All saved workouts will be deleted and settings reset. This can't be undone, so export your history first to keep a copy.

update.available: A new version of ErgScan is available.

drop.overlay: Drop the photo to scan it
drop.extra: Only the first image is scanned. | Only the first image is scanned; 1 other was ignored. | Only the first image is scanned; {count} others were ignored.

watch.matched: Heart rate added from your watch, matched on each split's stroke rate. The start time is now {time}.
watch.matchedByStart: Heart rate added from your watch, starting when it first counted strokes. The start time is now {time}; check the splits look right.
watch.noFit: That ZIP has no FIT file in it. In Garmin Connect, open the activity and choose Export Original, or pick the FIT file itself.
watch.unreadable: That file couldn't be read as a watch activity. Pick the FIT file, or the ZIP from Export Original in Garmin Connect.
watch.noHeartRate: That recording has no heart rate in it.
watch.tooShort: The watch recording covers less than half of this workout, so it can't be matched to the splits.
